central_question: Does observable state reproducibly segment the frozen FIRST-80 terminal payoff distribution in unseen games?

verdict.HEADLINE: B
verdict.note: TRAIN interestingness is not a discovery. OOS decides A/B/C/D.

G.rule: Adequate cells report n_rows, n_unique_trades, n_unique_games, TRADE_BALANCED.

universe.note: UNRESOLVED ≠ MODEL-ELIGIBLE. Universe remains 1230. Q=100 is research inventory, not production size.
universe.s5_redundancy: P_A1, P_A2, rel=A1-A2, and CR=A1+A2-100 are related market coordinates, not four independent discoveries.

clock_l2.note: OT is separately flagged and is not folded into LATE. Early-vs-late contrasts exclude OT.

hazard_accounting.rule: Primary h denominator is at-risk only (running min so far > 40 cents).

m01.M1_beats_M0_rule: (MAE_M0 - MAE_M1) >= 0.5 cents AND the game-clustered bootstrap 5th–95th interval of (MAE_M0 - MAE_M1) lies entirely above 0.
m01.meaning: Price dominance does not mean basketball state has zero association with payoff. It means additional state segmentation does not demonstrate sufficient reproducible information beyond the observed A1 price coordinate under the V5 protocol.
